# Appearance and publishing Specification

<!-- Generated by scripts/openspec.js from specs/ (Spec Kit is the source of truth for these requirements). Edit specs/NNN-*/spec.md or openspec/capabilities.json, then run: node scripts/openspec.js sync -->

## Purpose

How the extended site looks and how editors start posts from the site's own data, with channel versions that are never posted automatically.

## Requirements

### Requirement: REQ-053 Offer named design concepts that bundle a theme
In the extended version, the site SHOULD offer named design concepts that bundle a theme (follow the system, light, dark, high contrast, newsprint), a feed layout (list, compact, cards, magazine), a headline face and a text size; an admin SHOULD set the site default (audited) and choose whether readers may switch; a reader SHOULD be able to switch for themselves, kept in their own browser only. Themes change neutral tokens only, every theme keeps 4.5:1 text contrast, and the accent stays ink.

Source: `specs/005-appearance-and-publishing/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `modules/appearance/` (catalog, settings, routes, `/m/appearance`), `resolveLook`/`appearanceMenu` in `public/js/api.js`, `[data-theme|layout|type|size]` in `public/css/app.css`, theme contrast in `scripts/unslop.js`.

#### Scenario: REQ-053 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: publishing (REQ-053 checks); e2e: "REQ-053" in "Appearance and publishing")
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require

### Requirement: REQ-055 Generate a draft
In the extended version, an admin SHOULD be able to generate a draft (weekly digest, topic round-up, story explainer) written by rules from the stored stories, their scores and their explanations, which names no authors, attributes no claim to a person, says it must be checked, and stays a draft until a person publishes it; and SHOULD see channel versions of a saved draft (blog Markdown, newsletter, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, LinkedIn) within each network's length limit, never posted automatically and with no Twitter/X version.

Source: `specs/005-appearance-and-publishing/spec.md`, proposed, not approved: needs both partners. Code: `weeklyDigest`, `topicRoundup`, `storyExplainer`, `channels` in `modules/editorial/content.js`; `/api/admin/editorial/generate`, `/api/admin/editorial/posts/:id/channels`; Editorial CMS page.

#### Scenario: REQ-055 is checked
- **WHEN** the checks named in docs/SPEC_TRACE.md run (unit: publishing (REQ-055 checks); e2e: "REQ-055")
- **THEN** they pass, as preflight and the browser test require
